turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Doing well, thank you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We've moved in, but the place still feels like someone else's house.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's normal for a while. Small touches make a big difference, like hanging a few of your own pictures.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We haven't put a single thing on the walls.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Start there. Then add soft lighting, lamps instead of the big ceiling light make a room feel warmer instantly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. I want to plant garlic this autumn. Never done it before.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Easy and very satisfying. Do you want big cloves that store for months, or the kind with a flower stalk you can eat in early summer?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do we still have that voucher for the Italian place, Anna?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: It's in my wallet, expires Sunday.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sorry, one thing—

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, okay. Moshi, quiet for a minute.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Of course.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lucas, you're not seriously going out dancing again tonight?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's Friday! Come with me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got my pyjamas on already.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: At eight o'clock? You're eighty years old inside.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm comfortable inside. Will you at least text me when you get home?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine, Grandma. I'll text.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back with you. Go for it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We'd got to the garlic choice. Have you picked a type?
